# Inputs, end to end

Each block here checks something Inputs promises, so an Inputs that breaks one fails the test.

`config` is a form written in a fence inside the block. Its fields are in the form's order: `Name`, whose `order` is lowest, comes first.

<Inputs id="config">
```yaml
variables:
  - name: Region
    type: enum
    options: [us-east-1, eu-west-1]
    default: us-east-1
  - name: Count
    type: int
    default: 2
  - name: Name
    type: string
    order: -1
    validations:
      - required
```
</Inputs>

`deploy` reads it through `inputsId`. It runs once the required `Name` has a value.

<Command
  id="deploy"
  inputsId="config"
  env={{ NAME: "{{ .inputs.Name }}", REGION: "{{ .inputs.Region }}", COUNT: "{{ .inputs.Count }}" }}
  outputs={["seen"]}
  command={`echo "seen=$NAME/$REGION/$COUNT" >> "$RUNBOOK_OUTPUT"`}
/>

`greet` has a form of its own, inside it, which has no Submit.

<Command
  id="greet"
  env={{ WHO: "{{ .inputs.Who }}" }}
  outputs={["said"]}
  command={`echo "said=hello $WHO" >> "$RUNBOOK_OUTPUT"`}
>
<Inputs id="who">
```yaml
variables:
  - name: Who
    default: world
```
</Inputs>
</Command>
